TaskDescription: Object-location association learning stage (50 objects, each paired with a characteristic sound; feedback after placement). Segment extracted by the authors from 10 s before the first stimulus to 10 s after the last stimulus.
InstitutionName: Sanbo Brain Hospital, Capital Medical University
iEEGReference: Not documented in the release; signals as exported by the authors ("Raw intracranial electrophysiological signals"). The paper's re-referencing (common average / nearby white-matter contact) and notch filtering were analysis steps and are not applied here.
ElectrodeManufacturer: Huake-Hengsheng Medical Technology Co. Ltd, Beijing, China
iEEGElectrodeInfo: Intracerebral multiple-contact electrodes, 8-16 contacts, contact length 2 mm, diameter 0.8 mm, inter-contact distance 1.5 mm (Duan et al. 2025)
iEEGPlacementScheme: Stereotactic depth electrodes, robot-assisted implantation, placement by clinical needs
EpilepticActivity: No seizure occurred during the task period and sleep (Duan et al. 2025).
